title: Commercial Simulation
description: Hermes-native commercial simulation. Additive typing 1.1.0: required keys stay required and remain objects/arrays as emitted by recipes. Do not invent buyers, CAC, LTV, or revenue as OBSERVED. Gate B / NG-COMM-001: unit-econ OBSERVED needs evidence_refs. engine_tag stays PRISM-sidecar-only.

buyer_map.description: Gate C: separate economic_buyer from beneficiary. Additional role keys (user, payer, authorizer, risk_bearer) remain allowed.

economic_buyer.description: Who pays or authorizes. Use NOT_COMPUTABLE_until_declared when unknown; never invent a named buyer.

beneficiary.description: Who receives the value. Must not be silently collapsed into economic_buyer.

evidence_refs.description: Workspace or operator cites that separate roles. Empty when roles are still NOT_COMPUTABLE.

pricing_model.description: Packaging shape and assumptions. Assumptions are SPECULATIVE unless evidence_refs support a stronger label. CAC/LTV labeled OBSERVED without evidence_refs fail packaging (NG-COMM-001).

model_type.description: Optional typed packaging class. Recipes may still use free-text shape until a type is known.

assumptions.description: Model assumptions. Label SPECULATIVE unless evidenced.

cac.description: Customer acquisition cost. OBSERVED only with evidence_refs.

ltv.description: Lifetime value. OBSERVED only with evidence_refs.

cost_scenarios.description: Cost ranges with provenance. Object form (conservative/balanced/aggressive) remains valid; prefer scenarios[] when emitting labeled rows.

revenue_scenarios.description: Revenue ranges with provenance. Never invent firm revenue as OBSERVED.

scenarios.description: Optional labeled scenario rows (cost, revenue, or mixed). Each row needs a claim_label.

distribution.description: How the offer reaches a buyer. Object form used by recipes; string form allowed.

risks.description: Commercial failure modes, including buyer/beneficiary conflation and fabricated market size
